title: Drive Better Decisions with Project Health
summary: Find out why Project Health empowers your team to self-serve answers to common questions anytime, without waiting for reports or status updates.
body_markdown:
## Turn customer feedback into decisions you can trust.


Strong customer insights start with strong sample health. Without ongoing monitoring, issues like invalid contact information, duplicate records, and declining deliverability can create blind spots in your VOC program and reduce confidence in your results.


The good news is that most sample health issues can be identified and addressed before they impact survey performance. Learn practical strategies to validate sample files, monitor key metrics, evaluate segment representation, and detect potential risks early.


Don’t let those risks win. With Project Health by ConcentrixCX, you get real-time visibility into your sample data, empowering your team to give quicker responses, proactively address issues, and maintain the integrity of your customer feedback program.
